posts.t: Welcome back, Jason Zucker. Quinn spots him on the doorstep and feeds him for the redirect on the power play to cut it to 2-1.
Man Jason Zucker loves hockey. The Sabres have missed his energy.
Jason Zucker in his first game of the season gets the Sabres on the board with a net-front goal.
Zucker called for slashing, Flyers to the power play.
Jason Zucker has been activated and added to the Sabres' roster. Sam Carrick has been placed on injured reserve.
Rasmus Dahlin and Jason Zucker are both good to go, Lindy Ruff says.

Jason Zucker is working with the second power play unit at Sabres practice today. 

Justin Danforth and Sam Carrick aren’t on the ice

Some early week Sabres thoughts for you.

Lindy Ruff said the Sabres are targeting the next home game for Jason Zucker’s return. He’s been skating with the team on this road trip.
